items.title: 2027 oil price forecast: Where BofA thinks Brent is headed next
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America kept its forecast for Brent crude at an average of $80 a barrel in 2027, telling investors in a note that geopolitics will remain the main driver of oil prices.

items.title: Oil trades lower as Middle East strikes collide with rising Gulf flows
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices slumped on Friday, with U.S. crude advancing while the international benchmark paused for breath, as energy desks weighed a fresh wave of deadly Middle East attacks against recovering Persian Gulf shipping flows ahead of a pivotal OPEC+ meeting.

items.title: Europe gas prices rangebound as markets weigh Middle East tensions
items.summary: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices traded mixed to higher on Thursday, as energy desks balanced lingering supply relief against a sharp escalation in Middle Eastern hostilities that pushed crude oil higher.

items.title: Oil edges higher as Hormuz attacks threaten Persian Gulf supply recovery
items.summary: Investing.com - Oil prices climbed on Thursday, extending a blistering multi-session rally as a fresh barrage of attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz and critical Saudi energy infrastructure threatened to derail the fragile recovery in Persian Gulf crude shipments.

items.summary: Hershey, Altria, and Rollins gained Wednesday as the tech selloff deepened. Consumer staples have pulled ahead of tech since October.

items.title: Will Procter & Gamble's Restructuring Plan Sharpen Its Cost Base?
items.summary: PG is accelerating restructuring and productivity initiatives to sharpen its cost base, but rising input costs could limit near-term profitability gains.
